title: Odd regular Fontaine-Mazur over Q at two
exact_target: Must every continuous irreducible odd two-dimensional representation of the absolute Galois group of Q over $Qbar_2$, unramified outside finitely many primes and de Rham at two with distinct Hodge-Tate weights, be a Tate twist of the representation of a classical cuspidal eigenform?
